title: Senior SOC Analyst
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior SOC Analyst to join our team . This is a remote role, reporting to the Global SOC Manager in the Enterprise Security department . As a key guardian of our infrastructure, you will monitor, detect, and analyze security incidents to protect our digital assets . You will be the first line of defense, ensuring that potential threats are mitigated promptly and effectively to maintain a secure environment .

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Monitor security alerts and events to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities

• Detect and analyze security incidents using multiple security tools

• Respond to security incidents promptly, following established procedures and protocols

• Conduct in-depth analysis of security events to determine the scope and impact of potential threats

• Perform phishing incident analysis

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

• You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• 3+ years of experience in a Security Operations Centre

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field

• Familiarity with security technologies, including SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, firewall, and antivirus tools like Chronicle, Crowdstrike Falcon

• Familiarity with computer networks, various operating systems, and endpoint fundamentals

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience leveraging AI-driven anomaly detection tools, LLM-assisted threat hunting, or managing security risks associated with AI/ML infrastructure deployment

Defense Unicorns is seeking an Account Executive to lead business development and revenue growth across the aerospace market, including rotary-wing aircraft, fixed-wing aircraft, and space launch systems.

We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to.
You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work.

We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer.

Own outcomes, not tickets. Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself.

•
Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on. OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits.

Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade. A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten.

•
Work directly with customers. You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix.

•
Raise the bar on the codebase. Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit.

•
Push the team forward. Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted.

Who You Are

•
You ship. Ideas without execution do not count for you.

•
High agency. You do not wait for a card to be assigned. You see what is worth doing and you start.

•
Strong opinions, loosely held. You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts.

Curious about the domain. Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you.

title: Pastoral Coach
description:
Be Part of Something Eternal
Nearly 2 billion Muslims have never heard the saving message of Jesus Christ . At Frontiers , we believe God is calling His Church to change that. We partner with local churches to send workers to the Muslim world-workers who make disciples and plant churches where the Gospel has never been heard.
If you’re passionate about mobilizing the Church for global mission and equipping leaders to fulfill the Great Commission, this role is for you.
Coaching. Support. Shepherd.
As a Pastoral Coach, you’ll come alongside field workers serving around the world, providing spiritual encouragement, prayer, coaching, and relational support so they can thrive in their walk with Jesus and remain effective in their ministry. If you have a heart for missions, a passion for caring for others, and a desire to invest in the wellbeing of cross-cultural workers, this is an opportunity to make a lasting Kingdom impact.
At Frontiers , we believe God is calling His Church to bring the Gospel to the least-reached Muslim peoples. Our field workers serve in some of the most challenging and spiritually significant places on earth. Through intentional relationships, pastoral care, and Christ-centered coaching, the Barnabas Team helps sustain and strengthen those on the front lines of ministry. As a Pastoral Coach, you will play a vital role in encouraging, equipping, and caring for workers as they faithfully pursue God's calling among the nations.
About the Role
As a Pastoral Coach , you will:

• Seek to develop and maintain active relationships with field workers and their teams.

• Read newsletters and email updates from selected Frontiers field workers to keep track of their status and general wellbeing.

• Seek to debrief field workers upon their home assignment and follow up as necessary.

• When workers return from the field in transition or in another type of extended field leave, provide pastoral leadership and accountability as needed.

• Establish a rhythm of prayer and spiritual support encouraging field workers to thrive in their relationship with Jesus.

• Initiate relationships with workers at every opportunity. Seek to be available for encouragement, coaching, counseling and prayer.

• Raise 100% of your financial support (salary, benefits, ministry expenses)

What We’re Looking For

• A personal relationship with Jesus Christ and a heart for missions

• Previous missions experience either 2-3 years living overseas or extensive interaction with field workers.

• Heart for missions, cross cultural workers, Muslims and pastoring others.

• Ability to travel 2-3 times per year and willing to raise funds as needed for coaching trips and IC.

• Pastoral or Life Coaching experience preferred.

• A track record of being sought by people for pastoring, especially by field workers.

• Ability to travel occasionally and raise personal support

• Spiritual gifts in leadership, encouragement, and teaching

• Ability to raise and maintain personal support

Why Join Frontiers ?
When you join Frontiers , you become part of a grace-filled, mission-driven community that:

•
Prioritizes the least-reached - We focus on Muslim peoples with no sustainable Gospel witness.

•
Catalyzes movements - Everything we do contributes to planting healthy, reproducing churches.

•
Empowers teams - Our teams serve with a common vision and freedom to pursue locally appropriate strategies.

•
Values lifelong learning - We are dedicated to coaching, mentoring, and continuous growth.

•
Operates with integrity - Decisions are made by those closest to the action, ensuring effectiveness and accountability.

•
Work - Life culture - We encourage healthy rhythms, flexibility, and margin so team members can sustainably pursue their calling, invest deeply in relationships, and serve with excellence-both in the work and in the mission beyond it.

title: Self-Employed Estate Agent
description:
Build your own estate agency business with the support of Nested
At Nested , we believe great estate agents deserve more freedom, more support and a greater share of the rewards they create.
Traditional agency can be an excellent place to learn your craft, but for many experienced agents, it can limit earning potential, flexibility and autonomy.
Our platform enables ambitious estate agents to build their own businesses under a trusted national brand, whilst benefiting from industry-leading technology, marketing support and an experienced HQ team who understand the realities of estate agency.
Whether you're an experienced negotiator, valuer, branch manager, or already operating independently, Nested provides the tools, support and community to help you grow a successful business in your local area.
Why Join Nested ?
Keep More Of What You Earn
Unlike other self employed estate agency models, Nested allows agents to keep a significantly greater share of the revenue they generate. Starting at a 75/25 split, our commission structure is designed to reward growth and success, with agents able to earn up to 100% commission once their cap is reached.
Extensive HQ Support
Running your own business doesn't mean doing it alone.
From onboarding and compliance support through to marketing resources, operational assistance and ongoing training, our HQ team is on hand to help you focus on growing your business.
Modern Technology
Nested provides access to theCRM platform and technology suite designed to help agents manage their business efficiently, communicate effectively with clients and deliver an outstanding customer experience.
Income Support Package Available
We understand that transitioning into self-employment can be a significant step. For the right candidates, an income support package may be available to help you build momentum whilst establishing your pipeline.
The Opportunity
As a Self-Employed Estate Agent, you'll take ownership of building and growing your business within your chosen area.
You will be responsible for generating leads, conducting valuations, winning instructions, negotiating sales and managing clients throughout their property journey.
Unlike a traditional employed role, you'll have the freedom to decide how you work, where you work and how you grow your business, whilst benefiting from the support, systems and reputation of the Nested brand.
What We're Looking For
Ideally, you'll have:

• Previous estate agency experience within the UK

• Experience winning instructions and negotiating sales

• Strong local market knowledge

• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills

• A proactive and entrepreneurial mindset

• A genuine passion for delivering outstanding customer service

Most importantly, we're looking for individuals who are motivated to build a successful business and provide exceptional outcomes for their clients.
About Nested
Nested is led by CEO Alice Bullard and supported by an experienced HQ team, many of whom have enjoyed successful careers within estate agency themselves.
We understand the challenges agents face because we've faced them too.
Our mission is simple: to help great estate agents build thriving businesses through better support, better technology and a better way of working.
⭐ We're proud to be rated 5 Stars on Trustpilot, reflecting our commitment to delivering exceptional outcomes for our customers.
